title: INC-402 · Contradictory Sensors
summary: Two sensors watching the same uplink disagree by 15 Mbps, so no traffic split satisfies both readings.
description: Both sensors were configured to report the total across the same two uplinks. One reads 100 Mbps and the other reads 115 Mbps. Because their equations have identical left-hand sides, the system is contradictory rather than underdetermined.
investigationSteps: Confirm that both sensors are measuring the same pair of uplinks.
Write one equation per sensor reading.
Reduce the augmented matrix and look for a zero row with a non-zero constant.
Escalate the sensor fault before reporting any traffic distribution.
templateFindings: Both rows have the same coefficient left-hand side but different constants.
RREF produces the row [0 0 | 1], which reads as 0 = 1 and proves the readings cannot both be correct.
There is no valid traffic split, so averaging the two readings would hide the fault.
suggestedActions: Calibrate or replace the misreporting sensor and record the serial number.
Add one independent measurement, such as the difference between the uplinks.
Do not publish a per-link value until the system is consistent again.
